caption:
Less than two weeks until Battle of the Tech Bands Sydney — and ShipReX are on their way.

This is the performance that won them the Brisbane 2026 trophy: @rex_software and @urbanx.io taking on Foo Fighters' "Everlong" at The Triffid. Full pirate gear, an erhu in the line-up, and the trophy at the end of the night.

They join us in Sydney as special guests — Thursday 8 October, Manning Bar, alongside bands from Atlassian, Canva, Amazon and V2 AI. Tickets at battleofthetechbands.com

Full song on YouTube: youtu.be/gzcyKjD8IJA

Video shot by Aaron Griffiths and Kurt Boldy. Live audio by Nick Forrester.
Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. Brisbane raised over $3k for @youngcareoz, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
